units: Lam. R. to I, 1 רבתי (חד בר נש), v. דּוֹקְיָיא; Y. Maas. Sh. IV, 55ᵇ bot. [read:] מני עשרין … ק׳ דוקייא count twenty beams in thy house (counting upwards and downwards until you arrive at twenty), and thou shalt find thy father’s savings, kappa dokia (twenty beams; oneirocritical play on Cappadocia; v.
